{{Quote|Master Sifo-Dyas requested the most powerful army in the galaxy. We have worked with only the best shipbuilders to fulfill that request.|[[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
'''Rothana Heavy Engineering''' was a subsidiary of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], in operation prior to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Its headquarters was located on the eponymous remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rothana/Legends|Rothana]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].

==History==
After the mineral-rich [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Rothana was discovered in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] in [[800 BBY/Legends|800 BBY]], its location was sold to [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. KDY dispatched [[Quiberon Kuat]] to the planet with thousands of workers and a fleet of ships, creating a network of mines, factories and [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] that was the foundation of Rothana Heavy Engineering.

RHE became Kuat's primary subsidiary for pursuing secret projects. Far away from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], it was isolated from corporate espionage and only accessible by an incredibly-convoluted network of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes, the locations of which were issued on a strictly need-to-know basis.

[[File:ATTEcustom-SWE.png|thumb|left|250px|Rothana developed the [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE]] for the Republic]]
In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Rothana Heavy Engineering received an immense order from the [[Cloning/Legends|cloners]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to create war machines for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Working in absolute secrecy for nine years, the clandestine [[Project Icefang/Legends|Project Icefang]] oversaw the development of thousands of new assault ships, dropships, and walkers for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Equipment was shipped to Kamino via the [[Quiberon Line]], where the growing [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] tested and trained on their new machines. A handful of field tests were conducted elsewhere, but they were so few that sightings of [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TEs]] and other new designs were dismissed as fantasies.

Smaller Rothana warship models were noted for their characteristic "arrow"-shaped command towers. As the Clone Wars progressed, the shipyards quickly supplemented its successful assault ships with larger and more advanced designs such as destroyers and battleships.

After the Clone Wars ended, Rothana would still design and produce weaponry and vehicles for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but would not be as prominent as they were before. Still, even during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], certain [[Imperial II-class frigate|designs]] would still be influenced by their style. The Rothana yards were ultimately abandoned by the Empire just after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Aside from vehicle development, they also bred various mounted creatures for use among Imperial Army forces in the event that the environment was such that the Empire's mechanized scout vehicles could not operate without being put in the repair bays for weeks.
